description: This file is a CodeMirror addon that implements the highlightSelectionMatches feature, which highlights text in the editor that matches the current selection or token, with options for customization and scrollbar annotation.

classes.name: State
classes.description: Internal class managing the state of the highlight selection matches feature, including options, overlay, and scrollbar annotations.

methods.name: cursorActivity
methods.description: Handles cursor activity events to schedule highlighting.

methods.name: onFocus
methods.description: Handles focus events to activate highlighting.

methods.name: scheduleHighlight
methods.description: Schedules the highlight operation after a delay.

methods.name: addOverlay
methods.description: Adds a highlight overlay for the matching text.

methods.name: highlightMatches
methods.description: Performs the actual highlighting of matches based on current selection or token.

methods.name: isWord
methods.description: Checks if the selected text is a word boundary.

methods.name: boundariesAround
methods.description: Determines if the cursor is at a boundary suitable for matching.

methods.name: makeOverlay
methods.description: Creates an overlay object for highlighting matches.
